spans.s: Raṭṭaguḍi (EI 30), same as Raṭṭoḍī; official designation; probably the same as Rāṣṭrakūṭa.
Raṭṭagul̤l̤u (EI 27), probably, the same as Rāṣṭrakūṭa.
Raṭṭoḍi (EI 30), official designation; same as Raṭṭaguḍi.
Rāwa (EI 30), variant spelling of Rāva; derived from Sanskrit Rājan; title of nobility.
